subject.title: Testing guide + coverage matrix: exercise every connector lifecycle, with a two-tier CI gate before main

question: Should Crabbox operate a repository-owned, credentialed hosted-provider lifecycle-smoke tier, and if so which providers, credential boundary, spend ceiling, cancellation behavior, and orphan-cleanup owner are approved?
rationale: Current code and merged work deliberately stop before funded, secret-backed provider execution; this is an operational and security policy choice rather than a mechanical missing test.

options.title: Approve a small governed pilot
options.body: Start with a short allowlist in a protected environment, fixed spend caps, no pull-request access to secrets, and an explicit read-only audit plus escalation owner.

options.title: Retain hermetic coverage only
options.body: Keep the current secretless lifecycle and end-to-end gates as the repository CI boundary and leave cloud validation to provider/account owners.

options.title: Adopt a broader hosted matrix
options.body: Approve the proposed scheduled and dispatchable provider matrix only after staffing its credential rotation, quota, cancellation, and cleanup operations.

recommendation.title: Approve a small governed pilot
recommendation.body: Start with a short allowlist in a protected environment, fixed spend caps, no pull-request access to secrets, and an explicit read-only audit plus escalation owner.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged tier-one implementation and follow-up discussion establish the current boundary and remaining policy questions.
